reviewer_role: AI-assisted content triage; not human legal sign-off
scope: Six records previously labelled assistant_review_pass_candidate_only. Each exact text payload was opened and inspected. This overlay supersedes only the earlier assistant quality suggestion; it does not change NASA rights metadata or claim individual human review.
summary: The earlier assistant-pass label was too permissive. Five records show systematic OCR character loss (notably dropped 't' characters) and/or severely garbled tables; one is a slide/figure-heavy extraction with repeated graph axes and local browser-address artifacts. None should enter train without source-PDF re-extraction and a new exact-hash review.

records.title: Energy landscape in Ni-Co-Cr and related alloys
records.reason: Slide/figure-heavy extraction: repeated graph axes, duplicated figure labels and chart fragments dominate; local 127.0.0.1 browser address/timestamps leak into extracted text; usable abstract but body is not a coherent article.
records.next_action: Re-extract from source PDF with layout-aware OCR and retain only if the article body can be reconstructed coherently.
